जी हां, बॉलीवुड के दिग्गज अभिनेता Sunny Deol ने अब limited-edition Land Rover Defender OCTA Edition One खरीद ली है। इस बात की खबर तब सामने आई जब इसी कार के साथी मालिक Om Lombard ने सोशल मीडिया पर पोस्ट शेयर करके Sunny Deol का इस एक्सक्लूसिव क्लब में स्वागत किया।

Om Lombard ने अपने मैसेज में लिखा कि Sunny Deol न सिर्फ बड़े पर्दे पर बल्कि असल जिंदगी में भी एक मजबूत शख्सियत हैं। उन्होंने एक्टर के पहाड़ों और एडवेंचर के प्रति लगाव का जिक्र किया और लिखा कि सच्चे लीजेंड्स सिर्फ बने रास्तों पर नहीं चलते, बल्कि अपना नया रास्ता खुद बनाते हैं। 🏔️

Sunny Deol को हमेशा से ही SUVs और बड़ी गाड़ियों का काफी शौक रहा है। वहीं वर्कफ्रंट की बात करें तो वे सिनेमा और OTT दोनों जगह कई नए प्रोजेक्ट्स के साथ पूरी तरह एक्टिव हैं। 🎬

वैसे Sunny Deol की इस नई लक्जरी कार और उनके इस धाकड़ अंदाज पर आपका क्या कहना है? कमेंट्स में जरूर बताइए! 👇

ctx.title: Sunny Deol adds limited-edition Land Rover Defender OCTA Edition One to his luxury car collection
ctx.summary:
Actor Sunny Deol has added a limited-edition Land Rover Defender OCTA Edition One to his luxury car collection. The veteran star, known for his action roles and fondness for SUVs, has joined a select group of owners of the high-performance off-roader. The news came to light after fellow Defender OCTA owner Om Lombard welcomed Deol to the exclusive club through a social media post. Sharing his excitement over the actor’s latest acquisition, Lombard posted a note highlighting Deol’s screen persona, personality and association with adventure. His message read, “ANOTHER BIG NAME IN THE LAND ROVER DEFENDER OCTA CLUB — THE LEGENDARY MR. SUNNY DEOL! A legendary Bollywood actor, a man of strong character, and the proud owner of an exceptional, limited-edition Defender OCTA Edition One.” Lombard also drew a connection between Deol’s larger-than-life image and his reported love for travelling to the mountains. He added, “From the big screen to the breathtaking mountains of the Himalayas, Sunny Deol reminds us that true legends don’t just follow roads. They create their own paths. What connects us as Defender OCTA owners goes far beyond our passion for an extraordinary machine.” Concluding his message, Lombard wrote, “A love for adventure. A spirit of freedom. Strong personalities. And the courage to go beyond the ordinary. Different lives, different journeys, but the same passion. Respect to you, Mr. Sunny Deol. God bless you. Om LOMBARD.”

Actor Sunny Deol has added a limited-edition Land Rover Defender OCTA Edition One to his luxury car collection. The veteran star, known for his action roles and fondness for SUVs, has joined a select group of owners of the high-performance off-roader. The news came to light after fellow Defender OCTA owner Om Lombard welcomed Deol to the exclusive club through a social media post.
Sharing his excitement over the actor’s latest acquisition, Lombard posted a note highlighting Deol’s screen persona, personality and association with adventure. His message read, “ANOTHER BIG NAME IN THE LAND ROVER DEFENDER OCTA CLUB — THE LEGENDARY MR. SUNNY DEOL! A legendary Bollywood actor, a man of strong character, and the proud owner of an exceptional, limited-edition Defender OCTA Edition One.”
Lombard also drew a connection between Deol’s larger-than-life image and his reported love for travelling to the mountains. He added, “From the big screen to the breathtaking mountains of the Himalayas, Sunny Deol reminds us that true legends don’t just follow roads. They create their own paths. What connects us as Defender OCTA owners goes far beyond our passion for an extraordinary machine.”
Concluding his message, Lombard wrote, “A love for adventure. A spirit of freedom. Strong personalities. And the courage to go beyond the ordinary. Different lives, different journeys, but the same passion. Respect to you, Mr. Sunny Deol. God bless you. Om LOMBARD.”
Deol has long been associated with a preference for commanding vehicles, particularly SUVs, and is known to enjoy travelling to the Himalayan region. His latest purchase adds another high-end vehicle to a garage that has featured several luxury automobiles over the years.
Meanwhile, the actor continues to remain active on the professional front. Exploring cinema and OTT, Deol has several upcoming projects lined up, keeping him in focus as he continues his run across action and drama films. His latest automobile acquisition has also drawn attention from fans, offering a glimpse into his interests away from the big screen.
